invariants.rationale: The result is produced by the execute() method and returned; should never be null, following Option usage convention.
context must be non-null to schedule compaction actions.
instantTime is forwarded and used to schedule the compaction; chronic nulls would cause errors.
extraMetadata is passed through; Option should not be null.
Option is always present or not present. This is a tautology for Option, but it confirms that result is always a valid Option instance and not an uninitialized or corrupted object.
